title: Concept: Set-Cookie Expires date exceeds the 400-day browser cap
description: A far-future Expires is either a placeholder nobody revisited or an attempt to create a permanent cookie. Browsers cap the lifetime at 400 days anyway, so the declared value misleads reviewers about how long the credential lives, and the cookie outlives the session policy it was meant to follow.
applicability: Responses that set cookies with an Expires attribute.
risk: The credential persists far beyond the intended session window, which widens the period in which a stolen cookie is usable.
